job.title: MR Cylinder Driver
job.description:
Our client is a leading Australian supplier of gases and energy solutions, supporting residential, commercial and industrial customers across the country.

Perks:

  • $38.85 per hour
  • Casual ongoing opportunity
  • Monday to Friday roster – no weekends!
  • 6am to 2pm/3pm
  • Opportunity for overtime, particularly during the winter months
  • Varied, hands-on role combining driving, deliveries and warehouse/workshop duties
  • Opportunity to work with a well-established industry leader

About the role:

  • Complete multi-drop deliveries of LPG gas cylinders to residential, commercial and industrial customers.
  • Safely operate an MR delivery truck.
  • Load and unload cylinders using a forklift.
  • Manually handle gas cylinders weighing up to 20kg.
  • Inspect cylinders for damage, faults or leaks and report any issues.
  • Assist with workshop duties, including relabelling and painting cylinders.
  • Deliver professional and friendly customer service.
  • Follow all workplace health and safety procedures and safe manual handling practices.

About you:

  • Current MR driver's licence
  • Current LF ticket
  • Previous MR truck driving experience
  • Experience in a physical, hands-on role
  • Physically fit and comfortable lifting and carrying up to 20kg
  • Reliable transport to and from the workplace
  • Strong commitment to safety and safe work practices
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • Willing to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol test, police check and driving history check

If you are a confident MR driver who enjoys a hands-on role and takes pride in working safely? Join a well-established team and apply today!

job.title: HR Delivery Driver
job.description:
Our client is an established food distribution business supplying customers across metropolitan and regional NSW. They are seeking an experienced HR Delivery Driver to join their Strathfield team in a hands-on role combining deliveries and warehouse support.

Perks:

  • $40–$43 per hour plus penalties.
  • Ongoing casual work Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
  • Monday overnight accommodation in Muswellbrook arranged and paid for
  • A varied role combining driving, customer service and warehouse duties.

About the role:

  • Complete multi-drop food deliveries safely and efficiently.
  • Work Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, with 4:30 am starts and finish times dependent on the run.
  • Travel north to Muswellbrook on Monday, stay overnight and collect goods for the return trip to Strathfield on Tuesday.
  • Complete an additional delivery run on Thursday to Newcastle
  • Load and unload goods, including regular heavy lifting.
  • Complete delivery paperwork and vehicle safety checks.
  • Assist with picking, packing and general warehouse duties as required.

About you:

  • Current HR driver’s licence.
  • Previous HR driving experience, ideally completing multi-drop deliveries.
  • Available for all three days, early starts and the Monday overnight stay.
  • Comfortable with physical work, including loading, unloading and heavy lifting.
  • Reliable approach, good communication skills and friendly customer service.
  • Strong commitment to safe driving and workplace safety.

Looking for variety in your workday and a chance to put your HR driving skills to good use? Apply now and we will be in contact!

job.title: Administration Assistant
job.description:
This company is a leading FMCG wholesaler, with operations nationally, and requires an experienced administration & customer service assistant, to join the QLD team at the company’s head office, located in North Brisbane Brendale for a long term casual position.

This role would suit a confident self-starter, who has good computer literacy, organisation skills and a professional demeanor with customers.

Monday - Friday operation 7am - 3pm.

About the role:

  • Customer Service - phone & email communications.
  • Data entry & spreadsheet entry.
  • Raising and processing sales data.
  • Other admin duties as directed.

The ideal candidate for this role will have a sound administration background and who will be able to take control of the day-to-day duties for this role, is quick to learn and who can contact our client's customers, process, and enter sales orders, follow up general inquiries and other associated administrative duties.

About you:

  • Previous Administrative Experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Attention to detail
  • Good problem solving, organisational & prioritisation skills with the ability to manage change effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills – written and verbal
  • Sound level of computer literacy with knowledge of MS Office Suite, particularly Excel, Sharepoint and Outlook (experience highly regarded).
  • Well organised and efficient.
  • Ability to work as part of a team.
  • SAP preferred but not essential (training will be provided)

Please note candidates who meet the above criteria will be contacted for this position via email initially. This position is available immediately. Please ensure your resume & contact information is up to date.

job.title: Yard Hands
job.description:
We are currently partnering with a leading supplier of building and construction materials, based in Mt Druitt, who are seeking reliable and motivated Yard Hands to join their growing team.

These are ongoing casual opportunities offering full-time hours, with the potential to transition into a permanent position for the right candidates. This is a great opportunity to join an established industry leader and secure ongoing work.

  • Monday to Friday
  • 6:30am to 2:30pm
  • $39 per hour
  • Mt Druitt location

Key Responsibilites:

  • Lifting and stacking products
  • Preparing orders
  • Dispatching and receiving stock
  • Assisting with Inventory and stock control
  • Forklift operation - Loading/unloading trucks and moving stock
  • Manual handling tasks and assisting other teams

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in yard hand, labouring or warehousing positions
  • Current LF Ticket and demonstrated experience
  • Experience working with oversized or bulky products advantageous
  • Ability to complete manual handling tasks
  • Strong communication and time management skills
  • Current Drivers Licence and Reliable Transport

If you are an experienced Yard Hand looking for stable, ongoing work, we would love to hear from you. Please apply here with a copy of your updated resume.
